title: AC1024 generic associative-dependency graph closure
scope: Audit source-matched ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY targets, direct owner and network membership, dependency-body roles, target reactors, and reciprocal readdep/node chains for three AC1024 inputs. The audit checks graph structure and typed class identity only; it does not enable associative DXF output or claim consumer semantics.

independentReader.name: LibreDWG dwgread
independentReader.projectionMethod: Index OBJECTS and entity rows by absolute handle. For each ASSOCDEPENDENCY, resolve dep_on, dep_body, and ownerhandle; check target class, persistent-reactor backlink, the owning constraint group's action list, its owning network and network action list, dependency-body owner, and all non-null readdep/node targets for class, reciprocity, and common dep_on target. For block-parameter targets, resolve their owner EVALUATION_GRAPH and require one matching node expression handle.
independentReader.limitation: The independent projection corroborates these source profiles only. It does not qualify local DXF serialization, full recursive closure, or consumer semantics.

implementation.behavior: For AC1024, the bounded audit indexes typed dimension entities, dynamic-block constraint parameters, BLOCKPARAMDEPENDENCYBODY records, and evaluation-graph expression membership. It closes each generic dependency's dimension or block-parameter target, entity/block-parameter owner route, unique constraint-group action membership, group-to-network membership, correctly paired and singly owned dependency body, and one target reactor backlink. Block-parameter targets require one expression node in their owner evaluation graph and the exact ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCK dictionary entry. Non-null readdep/node links must resolve to another complete generic dependency, point to the same dep_on target, be reciprocal, and have their own valid owner/network route.
implementation.crossNetworkLinks: Source profiles include reciprocal dependency links whose endpoints belong to different constraint groups and networks. The audit verifies each endpoint route independently and does not require network identity equality.
implementation.strictOutput: Unchanged. Associative DWG output remains refused until complete graph serialization, handle remapping, and readback are implemented.

runtime.result: All 54 generic dependencies across the three imports closed with zero limits exceeded. Each CLI exited 1 with dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized, and no temporary DXF output was created.

validation.automatedTestSuites: Not run; the focused -Werror build, three existing-source imports, independent LibreDWG projections, and strict refusal/no-output checks were used for this source-graph audit slice.

limitations: Coverage is limited to the three bound AC1024 profiles, not every AC1024 file or other DWG versions.
The local mechanical DWG and generated peer projections/logs remain scratch evidence and are not committed as fixtures.
Action-body, direct action-dependency, and owned-parameter nonempty profiles remain unqualified until witnessed by a physical source input.
Associative DXF serialization, complete recursive closure outside this audited family, output readback, and native consumer semantics remain open.
nextAction: Implement source-to-emitted identity and field binding, handle remapping, complete reachable associative graph serialization, and readback while retaining atomic refusal for unsupported profiles.
